title: ANDS Studio — Guided filing journey
walkthrough:
You land on a page whose top bar reads "ANDS Studio" with the tagline "· file a drug like a story", plus links "Help", "My dossiers", and "Portfolio". The hero headline says "File a drug with Health Canada, like telling a story." A paragraph promises step-by-step guidance with "No regulatory background needed." You click "Start my submission →" (it shows "Starting…" while working). Fine print notes "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically".

The screen splits into three columns. On the left, a rail titled "Your filing journey" lists eleven steps, from "Get oriented" through "Set up your company", "Get your product's file number", "Start a submission", "Add your documents", "Check your submission", "Pay the fees", "Get it approved", "Sign", "Submit to Health Canada", and "Track & respond". Completed steps show "Done", the current one "You're here"; later steps are padlocked with reasons like "Complete "Set up your company" first." On the right, a 3D "Submission tower" graphic and a "Readiness" card showing "● BLOCKED" or "● READY TO FILE", a progress bar, and a blockers section headed "The single thing standing between you and ready:".

The center card starts at "Get oriented" with a "Tell me about your drug" form: "What's your drug?", a "What are you filing?" dropdown (e.g. "Generic of an approved brand (ANDS)"), a "Dosage form" dropdown, and a checkbox "It's for a new use the brand isn't approved for". You click "Check my pathway" and get a routing verdict and warnings.

Next, "Set up your company" asks for "Your Health Canada Company ID" (placeholder "e.g. 12345"); text explains you must email a Company Template to hc.osip-bpip.sc@canada.ca and wait roughly two weeks — or click "I've requested it — continue while it's pending →". The dossier step requires a "Dossier ID" in a specific format ("one letter + 6–7 digits, like e123456"); an on-blur check returns "✓ Valid Dossier ID format." or an error. You then enter "Applicant (your company name)" and "Drug product", and open documents via "Open the Module builder →"; the continue button stays disabled with "Place the required documents to continue" until required documents are in.

Validation runs automatically ("✓ Validation passed…" or "✗ … error(s) to fix"). The fees step has a checkbox "My small-business status is already granted". After review and signing steps, transmission explains Health Canada has no portal — you file via the US FDA gateway — and shows three receipt tiles: "FDA MDN", "FDA ACK", "HC ACK (Core ID)". The final step explains screening timelines and possible decisions.
